decisions.rationale: Myotonic dystrophy is a named disease with a single definition in the title and is not a further categorized family, so it is a Specific Disease mention.
The long form of the disease name introduced before the abbreviation is annotated as its own Specific Disease mention, separate from the abbreviation DM.

decisions.rationale: The abbreviation DM defined as the short form of myotonic dystrophy is a synonymous mention and is annotated separately from the long form as a Specific Disease.
DM here functions as an adjective modifying the noun phrase phenotypes in discordant DM phenotypes, so it is annotated as a Modifier.

decisions.rationale: The contiguous string covers several separate disease mentions (congenital DM, early severe childhood DM, and later childhood onset DM), so it is annotated as one Composite Mention.
DM in DM patients modifies the noun patients and is used adjectivally to describe the patient group, so it is annotated as a Modifier.
